description: This file implements an AudioHandler class for managing WebRTC audio streams, including handling buffers, stream parameters, and client communication in a virtualized environment. It interacts with audio sinks and sources, manages stream states, and processes audio data buffers.

classes.name: CvdAudioFrameBuffer
classes.description: A class representing an audio frame buffer for WebRTC, encapsulating audio data and its properties.

classes.name: AudioHandler
classes.description: Main class managing WebRTC audio streams, buffers, and client interactions.

classes.name: HoldingBuffer
classes.description: A nested class within AudioHandler for temporarily holding audio data during buffer processing.

methods.name: GetVirtioSndPcmInfo
methods.description: Constructs and returns a virtio_snd_pcm_info structure for a given stream direction and ID.

methods.name: BitsPerSample
methods.description: Returns the bits per sample for a given virtio audio format.

methods.name: SampleRate
methods.description: Returns the sample rate for a given virtio audio rate.
